urgent.heading: Shayela ku-10177 noma uqonde esibhedlela uma
urgent.primary_message: Ushukela wegazi ophakeme kakhulu noma ophansi kakhulu ungabeka impilo engozini emahoreni ambalwa. Lezi zimpawu zisho ukuthi — ungalindi.
red_flags: Ukoma ngokweqile ngokuphefumula okusheshayo - kungaba yi-diabetesic ketoacidosis (DKA)
Ukuphefumula okunezithelo noma okupholisha izinzipho (okujwayelekile kwe-DKA)
Ushukela wegazi ophansi - ukuthuthumela, ukujuluka, ukudideka okungathuthuki ngoshukela
Unyawo noma umlenze okhombisa ukutheleleka ngokuzumayo noma ibala elimnyama (unyawo lwesifo sikashukela)

what_is_it.heading: Isifo sikashukela ngokwemibandela ecacile
what_is_it.lede: Isifo sikashukela yilokho okwenzekayo lapho umzimba wakho ungakwazi ukuphatha kahle ushukela osegazini lakho. Kungenzeka ukuthi amanyikwe wakho awayenzi i-insulin eyanele (Uhlobo 1), noma umzimba wakho uyeka ukuphendula ku-insulin ngendlela efanele (Uhlobo 2).
paragraphs: I-insulin iyi-hormone etshela amangqamuzana akho ukuthi akhiphe ushukela (glucose) egazini futhi awusebenzisele amandla. Ngaphandle kwe-insulin eyanele - noma ngamangqamuzana angayinaki - ushukela uyanqwabelana egazini futhi ulimaze imithambo yegazi, imizwa, amehlo, izinso nezinyawo ngokuhamba kweminyaka.

Uhlobo loku-1 luvamise ukuqala ebuntwaneni noma ebudaleni obuncane futhi ludinga imijovo ye-insulin impilo yonke. Uhlobo 2 - okuyilona oluvame kakhulu - lukhula lapho umuntu esekhulile futhi luxhumene kakhulu nesisindo, ukudla, umlando womndeni, kanye nobuhlanga. I-Early Type 2 ngezinye izikhathi ingashintshwa ngokudla kanye nokulahlekelwa isisindo kuphela.

items.headline: 4.5 million
items.body: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baphila nesifo sikashukela. Cishe ingxenye ayazi ukuthi inaso.

items.headline: Uhlobo 2 = 90%
items.body: Isifo sikashukela esiningi kubantu abadala siwuHlobo lwesi-2 - sixhumene kakhulu nesisindo, umlando womndeni, nokudla.

items.headline: Ukunakekelwa kwamahhala
items.body: Ukuhlolwa kwesifo sikashukela, imithi ephuzwayo, kanye ne-insulin konke kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni.

items.headline: Ibuyiselwa emuva kusenesikhathi
items.body: Iziguli eziningi ezisanda kuxilongwa zohlobo 2 zingabuyela kushukela wegazi ojwayelekile ngokudla, ukuncipha kwesisindo, nokuzivocavoca.

pull_quote.text: Minyaka yonke imitholampilo ibona iziguli zilahlekelwa izinzwane, izinso, namehlo ngenxa yesifo sikashukela - cishe njalo ngenxa yokuthi lesi sifo sasihamba phambili ngaphambi kokuhlolwa. Hlola. Kumahhala.

signs.heading: Ongase ukuqaphele
signs.lede: Isifo sikashukela singakhula kancane ngokuhamba kweminyaka (Uhlobo 2) noma sivele emasontweni ambalwa (Uhlobo 1). Izimpawu zakudala kulula ukuzikhumbula - futhi abantu abaningi abanazo nhlobo kuze kuvele izinkinga.

items.title: Ezintathu zakudala
items.description: Ukuchama njalo, ukoma okukhulu, nokuncipha kwesisindo okungachazeki - ikakhulukazi ndawonye, ​​ikakhulukazi emasontweni ambalwa.

items.title: Ukukhathala nokululama kancane
items.description: Ukukhathala okungajwayelekile, ukungaboni kahle, ukusikeka kanye nezifo ezithatha isikhathi eside ukuphola, imvubelo evamisile noma izifo zomchamo.

items.title: Izimpawu eziyisixwayiso zohlobo 1
items.description: Ukwehla kwesisindo okungazelelwe ngokoma okukhulu, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni noma kubantu abadala. Ukuphalaza, ukuphefumula okujulile ngokushesha, umoya onezithelo, ukozela — isimo esiphuthumayo.

items.myth: Isifo sikashukela sibangelwa ukudla ushukela omningi.
items.fact: Ushukela unomthelela ekuzuzeni isisindo, okuyisici esiyingozi. Kodwa izakhi zofuzo, ukuma komzimba, ubuhlanga, kanye nokudla okuphelele kubaluleke kakhulu kunoshukela kuphela.

items.myth: Uma ungayidingi i-insulin, isifo sikashukela sakho asisibi kakhulu.
items.fact: Isifo sikashukela sohlobo 2 sibangela izinkinga eziningi - ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo, unhlangothi, ubumpumputhe, ukwehluleka kwezinso, ukunqunywa kwezitho - njengoHlobo loku-1.

items.myth: Abanesifo sikashukela ngeke baphinde bawudle ushukela.
items.fact: Inani elincane likashukela ekudleni okunomsoco ngokuvamile lilungile. Okubalulekile indlela yokudla iyonke, hhayi ukudla okukodwa.

items.myth: Uma isifo sikashukela sihlasela emndenini wami, akukho engingakwenza.
items.fact: Indlela yokuphila yehlisa ubungozi boHlobo 2 ngaphezu kuka-50%, ngisho nomlando womndeni oqinile. Izakhi zofuzo zilayisha isibhamu; indlela yokuphila idonsa inhlamvu.

prevention.heading: Uwehlisa kanjani ubungozi bakho
prevention.lede: Ukuvimbela kunamandla kakhulu uma kuqalwa ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izinkinga. Uma unomzali, ingane yakini, noma ingane enoHlobo 2 — ubungozi bakho buphezulu kakhulu futhi kuyindaba yokuhlolwa.

items.title: Isisindo esinempilo
items.description: Ikakhulukazi okhalweni. Ukulahlekelwa ngo-5–10% wesisindo somzimba engozini yohlobo 2 ngaphezu kwengxenye.

items.title: Hambisa nsuku zonke
items.description: Imizuzu engama-30 yomsebenzi omaphakathi - ukuhamba, ukugibela ibhayisikili, ukulima, ukudansa - izinsuku eziningi zesonto.

items.title: Ibhalansi yepuleti
items.description: Gcwalisa uhhafu wepuleti lakho ngemifino, ingxenye yesine nge-protein engenamafutha, ikota ngezinhlamvu. Sika iziphuzo ezinoshukela kuqala - umthelela omkhulu kakhulu.

items.title: Isikrini uma usengozini
items.description: Umlando womndeni, ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, iminyaka engaphezu kuka-40, umlando wesifo sikashukela ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa - cela ukuhlolwa koshukela egazini ngomunwe. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo.

items.title: Hlola
items.description: Ukuhlolwa koshukela wegazi ngeminwe kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo nasemakhemisi amaningi. Ukufunda ngokungahleliwe ngaphezu kwe-11, noma ukuzila ukudla ngaphezu kwe-7, kuphakamisa isifo sikashukela.

items.title: Uma uxilongwa, qala ukwelashwa
items.description: Ukudla kanye nokuzivocavoca kukodwa kungase kusebenze ku-Type 2 yakuqala. Iningi labantu ekugcineni lizodinga imithi yomlomo noma i-insulin. Konke mahhala emitholampilo kahulumeni.

items.title: Thatha imithi nsuku zonke
items.description: Ngisho nangezinsuku uzizwa kahle. Ikakhulukazi ngezinsuku ozizwa kahle. Isifo sikashukela senza umonakalo waso buthule kuyilapho ushukela uphezulu.

items.title: Hlola izinyawo zakho nsuku zonke
items.description: Isifo sikashukela silimaza imizwa ezinyaweni zakho - ungathola izilonda ezimbi futhi ungazizwa. Bheka, nuka, zizwela. Bonana nomtholampilo nganoma yisiphi isilonda esingapholi.

items.title: Ukuhlolwa kwamehlo nezinso kwaminyaka yonke
items.description: Isifo samehlo esinesifo sikashukela kanye nesifo sezinso sithule size sithuthuke. Ukuhlolwa kwaminyaka yonke kuyawathola ngesikhathi ukuze enze okuthile.

get_help.heading: Uzoqala kuphi
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa kwesifo sikashukela eNingizimu Afrika kumahhala lapho kunesidingo. Ingxenye enzima iyaqala - uma usukwenzile, uhlelo lwasemtholampilo lungathwala umthwalo omningi.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni inikeza ukuhlolwa kwesifo sikashukela mahhala, imithi, kanye ne-insulin
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo

helplines.name: Isifo sikashukela SA
helplines.description: Ulwazi, amaqembu okusekela, nokudluliselwa kwezazi zokudla
